title: Plinko
owner: src/platform/sounds.ts (Sounds). The pegs, the buckets' mallet notes and the coin are drawn in code; the music is a file.

events.label: Background music
events.trigger: Loops under the game while the menu's Music switch is on.
events.prompt: Relaxed instrumental Caribbean night groove, about 100 BPM, warm and dreamy but lightly uplifting: soft steel pan melody, marimba plucks, gentle kompa-style guitar skank, round bass and a laid-back percussion groove with shakers and congas; crisp modern production, steady even energy with no big build or ending so it loops seamlessly as casual game background music, no vocals.
